translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Yohanes
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I YOHANES

content: Kasi i Pilatus nondolo' i Yesus ka' nomosuu' mian membebot i Ia tia sambook.
Surudadu nanganam sa'angu' likok ruri' niwawau koi mahkota ka' nunsulon na takala' ni Yesus. Raaya'a uga' nimpisokimo i Ia tia juba kakamumu'.
Kasi i raaya'a nuntuu'i i Ia ka' norobu taena, “Tabea', oo tomundo' na lipu' Yahudi!” Kasi ia papagi i raaya'a a ro'up-Na.

Noko daa iya'a ai Pilatus no'umuarmo soosoodo ka' norobu na mian biai' taena, “Piile'! Yaku' nunguarkon i Ia, mimpipiile'kon na ko'omuu kada' inti'ionmuu se' i yaku' sianta nantausi sa'angu'po sala'-Na.”
Mbaka' i Yesus no'umuarmo, niposapeo'i ruri' ka' nojuba kakamumu'. Kasi i Pilatus norobu na ko'ona i raaya'a taena, “Piile' a mian kanono'.”

Sarataa tanaasna imam tari dadagai nimiile' i Yesus, raaya'a nangkakaro'mo taena, “Saliipkonmo a mian kanono'! Saliipkonmo a mian kanono'!” Mbaka' norobumo i Pilatus na ko'ona i raaya'a taena, “Alaka' wawa i Ia ka' saliipkon kuu-kuuna, gause i yaku' sianta nantausi sa'angu'po sala'-Na.”
Ia simbati samba Yahudi taena, “Mongololoikon koi men na ukummai, Ia tio ukumon pate gause i Ia mangaan se' waka-Na Anakna Alaata'ala.”
Sarataa i Pilatus nongorongor i raaya'a norobu koiya'a, ia nokanturanganmo a takutna.
Mbaka' ia ninsoopmo soosoodo na lalomna laiganna gubernuur, ka' sarataa i Yesus nisoopkon, Pilatus nimikirawarimo i Ia taena, “Koo ringkat aana?” Kasee i Yesus sian ninsimbati.
Mbaka' i Pilatus norobumo soosoodo taena, “Koo bude' morobu tii yaku'? Kada' bo inti'ioon, yaku' kuasaan bo munguarkon i Koo ka' kuasaan mansaliipkon i Koo!”

Ia simbati i Yesus taena, “Kalu Alaata'ala sian nantarai kuasa iya'a na ko'omuu, sabole i kuu sianta kuasaan na Ingku'. Mbali' iya'a, men balaki'na dosana tii kuu mase mian men nongorookon i Yaku' na ko'omuu.”
Sarataa i Pilatus nongorongor iya'a, ia nomoosarakmo bo munguarkon i Yesus. Kasee samba Yahudi mangkakaro' taena, “Kalu i Tuan munguarkon i Ia, Tuan taasi'po bela' ni Kaisar!
Mian men mangaan se' wakana tomundo', ia mian men sian pooka'amat tii Kaisar!”
Tempo i Pilatus nongorongor wurung men koiya'a, ia nangawawamo i Yesus umuar, kasi ia no'umoruang na oruangan pungukumian na tampat men ngaanion Dasar Watu. (Na wurung Ibrani ngaanna Gabata.)
Tempo iya'a toro jaam duablaas tanga'iloa', ka' koi liilana ilio ramean Paska. Pilatus norobumo na samba Yahudi taena, “Ni'imo a tomundo'muu!”

Mbaka' nangkakaro'mo i raaya'a taena, “Papatei i Ia! Papatei i Ia! Saliipkon a mian kanono'!” Pilatus nimikirawarmo taena, “Tio saliipkononku mbali' a tomundo'muu?” Ia simbati tanaasna imam taena, “Tomundo'mai tongko' Kaisar, sianta sambanaan!”
Mbaka' i Pilatus nongorookonmo i Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a bo saliipkonon. Yesus nisaliipkon 19:16b-27 (Mat. 27:32-34; Mrk. 15:21-32; Luk. 23:26-43) Raaya'a nangawawamo i Yesus.
Yesus no'umuarmo pasa-pasa'an saliip-Na mae' na tampat men ngaanon Lamasna Takala'. (Na wurung Ibrani ngaanna Golgota.)
Inda'a Ia nisaliipkon. Isian uga' rua' mian nisaliipkon singkat tii Ia, sa'angu' mian paraas kauri', sa'angu' mian paraas uanan ka' i Yesus na ola'na.
Na saliip ni Yesus i Pilatus nomosuu' mamakana' tulisan men koi kani'imari: Yesus samba Nazaret, Tomundo'na lipu' Yahudi.
Biai' a samba Yahudi mambasa tulisan iya'a, gause tampat men nansaliipkonan i Yesus sian oloa na kota. Tulisan iya'a na wurung Ibrani, wurung Latin ka' wurung Yunani.
Tanaasna imam norobu ni Pilatus taena, “Alia muntulis ‘Tomundo'na samba Yahudi’ kasee alaka' tulis, ‘Mian kani'i nangaan, Yaku' Tomundo'na samba Yahudi.’ ”
Kasee ia simbati i Pilatus taena, “Men yaku' poko tulismo sianmo kosapuian.”

Sarataa surudadu nansaliipkon i Yesus, raaya'a nangalamo pakean-Na. Pakean iya'a ni'obos paat, sanda-sanda' nandapot sangobosan. Raaya'a uga' nangala jubana. Juba iya'a koi toik saleak muntumbei nda'ana taka ro'ona, sianta kautanna.

Mbali' iya'a, raaya'a nopootunduniimo simbaya'na taena, “Alia i kita mongobos juba kaya'a men tongko' toro samberakan. Mai kita undia kada' inti'ion too ime a men mandapot.” Men koiya'a nosida kada' sida a upa men ningaan na Alkitaap taena,
Ka' uga' surudadu iya'a nangawawau men koiya'a.
Karani' saliip ni Yesus isian sina-Na, ka' isian sa'angu' wiwine men utusna sina-Na, ka' i Maria boroki' ni Klopas, ka' i Maria Magdalena potokerer.
Sarataa i Yesus nimiile' sina-Na ka' murit-Na men kolingu'-Na potokerer karani' i Ia, Ia norobumo na sina-Na tae-Na, “Mama, nono' a anakmuu.”
Kasi i Yesus norobu na murit-Na iya'a tae-Na, “Nono' a sinaam.” Supupo iya'a sina ni Yesus nodumodongomo na laiganna murit iya'a.
Nolapusan ni Yesus
Yesus ninginti'i se' giigii' noko daamo, ka' kada' sida a upa men nitulismo na Alkitaap, mbaka' Ia norobumo tae-Na, “Yaku' moro'u.”

Indo'o isian sa'angu' mangko' men buke' tia anggur makarang. Mbaka' i raaya'a nongoromkonmo garanggan mongura' na anggur men makarang ka' potoor na kau hisop itiu' sangkolong, kasi nondoekon paraas nganga' ni Yesus.
Noko daa i Yesus nonsosop anggur makarang iya'a, ia norobumo taena, “Daa pupulmo.” Kasi Ia nuntutuku'kon takala'-Na ka' nolapus.
Yesus ni'usuk

Ilio iya'a batoropotan ilio Sabat men ramean balaki'. Gause moomoola'na Yahudi bude' biibii iya'a poto ndoeng na saliip na ilio Sabat, mbaka' notakamo i raaya'a ni Pilatus ka' mama'ase' na ko'ona kada' saratna i raaya'a pato'on ka' biibiina taro'konon.
Mbaka' surudadu ni Pilatus nomae'mo ka' nongolukoni namato' saratna mian rua' ira men nisaliipkon singkat tii Yesus.
Sarataa i raaya'a notaka inde'e ni Yesus, ia piile' i raaya'a noko lapusmo. Mbaka' i raaya'a sianmo namato' saratna.
Kasee isian sa'angu' surudadu nungusuk i Yesus tia kalait paraas rusuk-Na pataka liuliu no'umuar a rara' tia weer.
Mian men nimiile' upa men nosida iya'a, iamo a men nuntundunkon kani'i kada' i kuu uga' mamarasaya. Upa men ia tundunkon iya'a tuutuu' ka' inti'ionna se' upa men bantilkonna iya'a kana'.
Men koiya'a nosida kada' sida a men nitulis na Alkitaap taena, “Sianta sa'angu'po a wukuna men bo pato'on.”
Na Alkitaap uga' isian nitulis taena, “Raaya'a bo mengelelengea' i Ia men ia poko usukmo.”
Yesus nitanom

Noko daa iya'a, Yusuf samba Arimatea nama'ase' ni Pilatus mangala biibii ni Yesus. (Yusuf iya'a murit ni Yesus kasee wuni-wuni gause layaonkon moomoola'na Yahudi.) Pilatus nomoturang i ia, mbaka' ia nomae'mo nangala biibii ni Yesus.
Nikodemus men mbaripian isian notaka ni Yesus tempo malom, uga' nomae' tii Yusuf. Nikodemus nangawawa mina' muur men nilauk tia mina' gaharu, wiwi'namo toro tolumpulo' kilo a kobiai'na.
Raaya'a rua' ira nangalamo biibii ni Yesus ka' nambalun tia toik pobalun ka' nintimbu'i tia minamina' iya'a mongololo' koi adatna samba Yahudi kalu mantanom biibii.
Karani' tampat men nansaliipkonan i Yesus isian sa'angu' taman. Na taman iya'a isian baleanan u'uru men sianpo nipokelaii biibii.
Gause ilio iya'a batoropotianna samba Yahudi bona ilio Sabat, ka' baleanan iya'a daa karani', mbaka' i raaya'a nomokelamo biibii ni Yesus inde'e.
